subject: Request: Exec approval for >20% Hosted API concession — Crucible.ai
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@crucible.ai>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing / pilot scope and ask

Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput on short-context calls looked great. We ran a quick internal forecast and we expect to exceed our initial pilot consumption by mid-Q1 if we move forward with the planned integration.

Two asks from my side before we finalize the PO: 1) a committed pilot rate with a stepped usage discount (we're looking at ~25% off list for the first 6 months given expected volume), and 2) a short data retention carveout in the contract for our PHI-adjacent telemetry.

I've attached a rough usage forecast (Crucible_MAAP_usage_forecast.xlsx) and looped in contracts@crucible.ai for legal questions. Happy to jump on a call to walk through numbers.

— Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Engineering, Crucible.ai
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@crucible.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, contracts@crucible.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing / pilot scope and ask

Samir — really appreciate the forecast and the candid ask. Quick notes:

- We can do a committed pilot program with a stepped rate, and pricing can be structured as a blended per-token rate for the committed period.
- For discounts above our standard regional band, we'll need an exec signoff (greater than 20% off list triggers CC-level approval).
- Data retention exceptions are usually handled with a Private deployment agreement; for hosted we can consider a shorter retention window and contractual language, but will need security signoff.

Ben, could you confirm month-by-month economics on a 6-month committed pilot at 25% off list and whether a blended commitment or blocks model is cleaner here? Also can you start a thread with finance/legal if we need non-standard retention language.

Samir — I'm free tomorrow 10–11am ET if you'd like to review together.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir@crucible.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing / pilot scope and ask

Naomi / Samir — I ran the numbers off the forecast you sent. Two practical options:

A) 6-month committed pilot, blended per-token rate with 25% off list; volume commitment ~2.1B tokens over 6 months. Effective cash for Redwood is roughly 18% lower than our standard bucket economics once we account for expected overages and prefix caching.

B) 6-month blocks model (prepaid blocks at 30% off list, with smaller overage penalty) — that pushes Redwood unit economics unfavorably beyond a 30% discount but protects predictability.

Because the ask is >20%, this needs exec sign-off. cc'ing Stephanie and proposing the approval memo below:

- Account: Crucible.ai
- Proposal: 6-month committed pilot, blended rate with 25% host API discount for committed volume, standard overage cliffs apply
- Strategic rationale: potential multi-region enterprise expansion, high likelihood of conversion to Dedicated within 12 months, reference value in fintech vertical
- Risk: short-term margin impact; requires a rev-rec plan and a monitoring SLA
- Attachments: usage forecast, initial contract redline

Stephanie — can you review and advise whether we can recommend this for exec OK, or if finance needs a revenue-protection clause added (e.g., minimum realized price)?

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir@crucible.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T13:27:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing / pilot scope and ask

Ben — thanks for the memo. A few finance asks before I recommend exec approval:

1) Add a minimum realized revenue clause: if actual net realized ARR falls below 85% of projected, we reserve the right to re-price for the remainder of the term.
2) Include a short audit right (quarterly spot-checks) tied to the committed volume.
3) Require that conversion to Dedicated (if requested) includes a fair-market reconciliation.

If those are acceptable to Crucible, I'm comfortable supporting a recommendation for an executive concession up to 28% for the 6-month pilot. Anything beyond that we should escalate to Rishi with a clear counterfactual ROI model.

Samir — happy to join a legal/finance sync to finalize contract language.

— Stephanie
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@crucible.ai>, contracts@crucible.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T10:15:00-05:00
Subject: Exec approval: Crucible.ai pilot concession (up to 28%)

Team — after reviewing Stephanie's conditions and Ben's economics, I authorize an executive concession for this pilot up to 28% off list for a six-month committed term, subject to the following mandatory contract items:

1) Minimum realized revenue clause as described (85% threshold).
2) Quarterly usage audit right (limited scope, non-disruptive).
3) Clause specifying pricing reconciliation on Dedicated migration.
4) Standard indemnities and SOC 2 evidence for hosted retention carveouts; if PHI handling is needed beyond our current offering, we will require Private deployment or an addendum.

Naomi — please proceed to finalize the PO with these terms and get legal signoff on the redline. Ben/Stephanie — loop me if there are material deviations.

— Rishi
Chief Revenue Officer (acting) — Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@crucible.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, contracts@crucible.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T17:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval: Crucible.ai pilot concession (up to 28%)

Samir — good news: Rishi approved up to a 28% concession conditioned on the three finance items and SOC 2 evidence for the retention exception. Contracts, please incorporate the minimum realized revenue and the quarterly audit language in the PO.

Next steps for Crucible:
- Confirm you accept the 6-month committed pilot at 28% off list with the minimum realized revenue clause (we'll seed the initial block at day 1)
- Legal: review the attached redline and indicate any non-negotiable items by EOD Tuesday
- Naomi/Ben: we'll prepare the final PO and payment instructions once legal aligns

Samir — can we do a short sync Wed 11am ET to close?

Thanks everyone,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Contract_redline_v2.pdf (redline summary), Crucible_MAAP_usage_forecast.xlsx (usage forecast)
